bibl.title: Dating Early Ptolemaic Salt Tax Receipts: the Egyptian Tax Year.
bibl.seg: Jos Paulissen & Katelijn Vandorpe, Dating Early Ptolemaic Salt Tax Receipts: the Egyptian Tax Year.
bibl.note: 1. Corpus of salt tax receipts. - 2. The dates of receipts: Greek financial year (GFY) and Egyptian civil year (ECY). - 3. The tax years in receipts: Greek tax year (GTY) and Egyptian tax year (ETY). - 4. Traditional, problematic dating system: Egyptian tax year = Egyptian civil year. - 5. New dating system: introduction of an independent Egyptian tax year. - 6. Origin of the Egyptian tax year and relation to the Greek financial / tax year. - 7. Summary and consequences of the new dating system. - Appendices: I. The rates of the salt tax; - II. The special case of OrSu 27-8 (1978/9) p. 6 no. 1 [O. Berol. Inv. 6369]; - III. The Egyptian tax year in Greek and bilingual papyri from Middle Egypt.
